parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The canonical production implementation of `DebugMetricsProvider.updateMetrics` resides in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`); the duplicate in `DebugHUD.swift` is a demonstration fixture for the Wallpaper sample app. Consolidating these would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The correct resolution, if the duplication is unwanted, is to delete or simplify the sample-app copy — not to extract shared production code.
